line: The telegram said 57 seconds; under a loupe, the Wrights' glass negatives and the archive say 59.
line_cn: 电报说最长飞了 57 秒；放大镜下，莱特兄弟的底片和档案说是 59 秒。

camera.expresses: surveying; moving to the next piece of evidence
camera.serves: a timeline of documents; a product family; an album

camera.move: loupe landing + push into the lens
camera.serves: the claim; the key photograph; a signature

camera.move: inside the lens: tracking along a line
camera.serves: a letter, a ledger line, a caption, a spec
the event itself; the founding moment; the place

camera.move: pull back to the whole table
camera.serves: an index, a timeline, a closing

transitions: Transitions are made by the loupe (land, push, rise, lift) and the glide;
no cuts, fades to black or page turns between objects.
labels: Roles: a monospace for identifiers, dates and readings (e.g. IBM Plex Mono, 17–34 px; readings 74–120 px); a sans for labels in the film's language (e.g. Noto Sans SC or Inter, 21–36 px); a serif only for titles and the one name a photograph carries (60–76 px). OFL, self-hosted, CJK subset when needed.

Labels attach to objects: an anchor dot and ring, a vertical leader, then the text. A reading sits in a dark caption plate with a small label above and the source (the catalogue number or the original wording) below.
Subtitles are a caption strip at the bottom centre, on a dark plate with a 3 px signal-coloured edge. If the film is bilingual, the film's language goes on top. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
Quote the source when you can: a crop of the actual line, or the record's wording in quotation marks, beats a paraphrase.
motion: 24 fps on ones; every camera parameter on smooth monotone curves through keys (no overshoot, no stepping).
The camera glides across the table, slows to let the loupe land, then pushes. Speed lives in the glides and pushes; holds are for reading.
The loupe lands with a fast ease-out (≈ 0.4 s), lifts the same way. Lines draw on in 0.3–0.6 s; text wipes in from its leader side; numbers count up and land with the voice.
What never moves: the archive's own content outside a photograph space, and the table itself.

native_moves.name: Negative to positive under the loupe
native_moves.does: A develop front spreads from the lens centre with a thin warm edge, turning the glass negative into its positive only inside the lens.
native_moves.fits: a founder's portrait plate; a factory on a lantern slide; an X-ray film becoming the product inside.

native_moves.name: The line lights up
native_moves.does: On paper inside the lens one line of type brightens while the rest dims, an underline draws under it, and one word or number lifts out into a reading card.
native_moves.fits: a ledger entry; a patent claim; the first order on an invoice.

native_moves.name: Into the photograph
native_moves.does: The lens rim grows past the frame while the view inside widens; the photograph gains layered depth and a subject drifts.
native_moves.fits: the first shop front; a launch day crowd; an expedition camp.

native_moves.name: Measuring on the photograph
native_moves.does: A ruler laid on the ground plane in perspective, with ticks that crowd toward the horizon and a counter that lands on the recorded figure, marked as a schematic when it is one.
native_moves.fits: a race distance; a bridge span; a building's height.

native_moves.name: Two records, held side by side
native_moves.does: Two caption cards, each with a crop of its source, held still until both are read before one is struck.
native_moves.fits: a misprinted date; two versions of a founding story; specification against delivery.

native_moves.name: The table becomes the index
native_moves.does: Pull back to the whole table; each object's tag flies into one list with its identifier and its reading.
native_moves.fits: a company timeline; a collection catalogue; a product family.

score.note: restrained: felt piano, a few strings, glass for seeing
